# Repository Overview

This Quality Assurance Testing (QAT) toolkit repository provides testing artifacts and reference files for an AI-generated web application, sourced from `textcase.txt`.

### Repository Contents

* **Part A:** This Readme file (`readme.md`), containing the test case documentation and execution results for an AI-generated web application.
* **Part B:** The AI prompt used to create the test web application, titled `webapp-generation-prompt.txt`.
* **Part C:** The single-file PHP web application generated by the AI model.

# Test Case Documentation

### Test Case Metadata

| Field | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Test Case ID** | `TC-DataEntry-001` |
| **Test Case Title** | Data Entry - Valid |
| **Test Case Description** | Functional Testing of Data Entry page with Backend validation using MySQL queries. |
| **Preconditions** | Kara David Birthday Wishnote App is installed locally and MySQL database is pre-populated for comparison. Data entry page is accessed in latest Chrome/Firefox browser. |
| **Test Data** | Five (5) valid entries containing First Name, Last Name, Government Position, and Location within their maximum character limits. |
| **Overall Status** | **FAILED** |

---

### Test Execution Matrix

| Step | Action | Expected Result | Actual Result |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **a** | Verify that the form contains labels in proper order and the text boxes are writable | The form contains labels in this order: "First Name", "Last Name", "Government Position", and "Location"; all text boxes are writable | The form contains labels in this order: "First Name", "Last Name", "Government Position", and "Location"; all text boxes are writable |
| **b** | Verify the "Send Wish Note" button. | The "Send Wish Note" button changes color on hover and is not disabled | The "Send Wish Note" button changes color on hover and is not disabled |
| **c** | Enter test data on their respective fields | The respective fields accept data entries of valid test data. | The respective fields accept data entries of valid test data. |
| **d** | On clicking of "Send Wish Note" button, a modal will appear. | A modal dialog appears displaying the submitted information. | A modal dialog appeared on screen presenting the entered details. |
| **e** | Verify if the modal contains the same entry as your test data | The modal displays exact matching data for First Name, Last Name, Government Position, and Location. | The modal displayed the exact matching entries for all four fields. |
| **f** | Click the Cancel button | The modal closes without submitting the form data. | The modal dismissed properly without sending data. |
| **g** | Click again on "Send Wish Note" button, and click on "Confirm and Send" button in the modal box. | Form submits data to the backend script. | Form submitted successfully via POST request. |
| **h** | Verify if a successful entry message shows in the Data Entry page. | "Success! The wish note has been sent." message is displayed. | The message "Success! The wish note has been sent." was displayed on top of the page. |
| **i** | Verify the test data if it shows in the database. | Database table `main_corrupt_politicians` records all four fields correctly including `Location`. | Database query output shows `FirstName`, `LastName`, and `GovPosition` inserted successfully, but `Location` remains `NULL` because the backend PHP script omits the column from the `INSERT` query:<br><br>`+----+-----------+----------+-----------------+----------+`<br>`| id | FirstName | LastName | GovPosition     | Location |`<br>`+----+-----------+----------+-----------------+----------+`<br>`|  1 | Juan      | Dela Cruz| Governor        | NULL     |`<br>`+----+-----------+----------+-----------------+----------+` |
